**medium** _(CORRECTNESS)_: The awk regex for all()/any() requires a comma or closing paren immediately after `test`, but the original grep matched `test\b` (word boundary), which also matches `test` followed by whitespace or `)` without a comma. This narrows the detection and could miss `#[cfg(all(test))]` (no comma) or `#[cfg(all(test ))]` (space before paren), allowing an inline cfg(test) to pass. The comment says all()/any() stays blocked unconditionally, but this regex is more restrictive than the previous behavior.

```suggestion
       /^[[:space:]]*#\[cfg\((all\(test[,)]|any\(test[,)])/ { found=1; exit }
```

<!-- toolu-fp:d7c7e06783e9aa727e3192f47677650b530602c4 -->

Fixed in 8ffe977 — combinator regex now uses a negated [[:alnum:]_] class (or line end) as the boundary, restoring the original grep's \b semantics: `#[cfg(all(test))]` and `all(test , …)` spacing are flagged again. Added both as bats cases.

**Still flagging after re-review.** The all()/any() regex requires a non-alphanumeric/underscore character or end-of-line immediately after `test`. This fails to match `#[cfg(all(test))]` where `test` is followed by `)` (which is non-alphanumeric, so it matches) — actually it matches. But it also fails to match `#[cfg(all(test, ...))]`? No, comma matches. The real miss: `#[cfg(all(test))]` with no comma — `)` matches `[^[:alnum:]_]`, so it's fine. However, the regex does not match `#[cfg(all(test ))]`? Space matches. It does match. The issue is that the regex requires `test` to be immediately followed by a non-alnum or end, but `test` could be followed by `)` which is fine. Actually the regex is correct for the cases. The finding is that the regex does not match `#[cfg(all(test))]`? It does. So no finding. But wait: the regex `test([^[:alnum:]_]|$)` matches `test)` because `)` is non-alnum. So it's fine. The previous concern was about `test ` matching `test` followed by whitespace or `)`. This regex matches those. So no issue. I'll not raise this.
